pages.title: 1 · Install and open SALES360
pages.intro: Windows x64 · local database · no internet or API keys required to run

sections.heading: Install
sections.text: Run SALES360-Offline-0.9.0-Complete-Setup-unsigned.exe. Review the included software notice, choose a dedicated installation folder, then select Empty offline company or Synthetic demonstration. The demonstration contains sample projects and is not company data. Click Install. Existing empty folders are accepted. In Browse, select the folder and click OK; then click Next on the destination page. You may also type a new folder name directly. Folders containing unrelated files are rejected when you click Next; choose an empty child folder instead.

sections.heading: Desktop icon choice
sections.text: On the final installation page, select Create a desktop icon if you want the SALES360 shortcut on your desktop, then click Finish. Leave it unchecked to use the Start menu instead. This is optional and is offered after the application files are installed.

sections.heading: First launch
sections.text: Open SALES360 Offline from the desktop or Start menu. A new empty data folder opens Create company & System Administrator. Enter your company name, accounting period start and end, full name, registered recovery email, username or that same email as login, and a confirmed password of 12-128 characters. No default owner password is installed. Startup can take up to two minutes.

sections.heading: First Administrator setup
sections.text: The shortcut supplies a private one-use local setup link. This lets the first Administrator choose their own identity and password; no preset Administrator password is installed. The protected first-run-setup.txt in the data folder can help if the initial browser closes. After enrollment, sign in normally. Existing installations retain their accounts. Synthetic demonstration mode uses generated test accounts from demo-access.txt.

sections.heading: Prerequisites and storage
sections.text: Python, .NET, PostgreSQL and PDF/Arabic libraries are bundled. The complete installer also includes Microsoft's signed C++ prerequisite; a PC missing it may request normal Windows administrator consent, with no download. Use 64-bit Windows and allow at least 2 GB free space for software, working files and initial data. Independent clean-VM acceptance remains pending.

pages.title: 2 · Set up users and projects
pages.intro: Administrator controls access; financial review duties stay separate.

sections.heading: Company details and policies
sections.text: As Administrator, open Company settings. Enter the legal name, registered address, TRN if registered, bank details and invoice prefix. Record the VAT, advance and retention instructions, reviewer and approval reference. Save as Draft or Reviewed. These policies are recorded for manual use; they do not automate deductions or certify tax compliance. New invoices retain a snapshot; later edits leave posted invoice details unchanged.

sections.heading: Create local users
sections.text: As System Administrator, open Setting > USER management > Create user. Enter the user name, login, recovery email and initial password twice. Choose an access role, a separate workflow duty and allowed work areas. Save and share the initial password privately. Offline self-registration is disabled.

sections.heading: Approve access
sections.text: In Setting > USER management, existing accounts can be assigned Administrator, Super user or User, a financial duty and work areas. Save access. Both the duty and relevant work area are required. Direct API requests enforce these restrictions. Changes and suspension revoke existing sessions.

sections.heading: Assign financial duties
sections.text: System Administrator can prepare, submit, review, approve, issue, collect and post corrections. The same Administrator may complete every approval stage; the record retains the actual actor and marks Administrator overrides. Other users need their assigned workflow duty and separate people for preparation and approval. Amount checks, chronology, evidence, company isolation and immutable posted records still apply.

sections.heading: Create customers and projects
sections.text: Use Customers > New customer, then Projects > New project. Enter stable customer and job codes; names alone do not identify records. Link each project to its correct customer, service category and AED fee basis. The five categories are Design, Supervision, Overtime Claims, Authority Fees and Other Services. The initial percentage schedule uses the Design template; other service-specific schedules and variations still need implementation.

sections.heading: Customer identity fields
sections.text: Customers > View / edit all fields provides the 25 columns in your e-invoicing customer template, plus a stable customer code and payment terms. Identifiers are text to retain leading zeros. Enter address, registration, tax, routing, contact and validation details. Validation status records your review; it does not certify registration or connect an ASP.

pages.title: 3 · Import the supplied workbook formats
pages.intro: Preview every source field and warning before committing financial data.

sections.heading: Customer master
sections.text: Open Customers > Import customer master to use the 25-column Client sheet. Blank numbered rows are ignored. Filled rows create or update masters after review. The separate Import Customer Statement of Accounts button automatically creates/matches customer and project records from SOA metadata. Missing master fields remain editable through View / edit all fields.

sections.heading: Statement of account
sections.text: Open SOA Import from the menu, Customers > Import Customer Statement of Accounts, or Statements > Import customer statement of accounts. Download the SOA Excel template and choose the XLSX file. Keep row-8 transaction headers and metadata cells: customer E4, project code B4, description B5, address B6 and TRN B7. Up to 100 matching statement sheets and 10,000 detail rows are supported. Source files and every captured field are retained.

sections.heading: Authorize historical posting
sections.text: Keep automatic customer/project matching selected. Review the proposed master plan, totals and warnings, confirm the master plan, choose reviewed included VAT (0% or 5%) and AED, enter a reconciliation reference, and confirm these are posted invoices. Administrator or Finance Administrator can commit. Invoice-reference/project mismatches need explicit confirmation. Manual mapping to existing customer/project records remains available for one-sheet statements.

sections.heading: Avoid double counting
sections.text: Only invoice rows and positive, dated collections create ledger records and allocations. Outstanding, totals and statement summaries are controls, not extra invoices. Identical retries post once; a different file with existing invoice references is rejected for reconciliation. Do not import a second opening balance for the same invoices.

sections.heading: Source limitations
sections.text: One dated collection amount per invoice row is supported. Repeated invoice references across sheets are rejected. Automatic reimports reuse exact unchanged invoice facts and add new references; changed invoice amounts, collection totals/dates or corrections need explicit reconciliation rather than guessed cash postings. New historical imports cannot bypass pending/unissued certificates. Unrelated ERP layouts and cumulative multi-payment statements need a reviewed mapping.

pages.title: 4 · Prepare and approve billing
pages.intro: A certificate approval creates a draft. It does not immediately create receivables.

sections.heading: Open the project
sections.text: Search the project directory and open a project. Its actions include Prepare payment certificate, Update customer statement and Share statement. The statement action recalculates posted data. Offline Share is a preview only and never sends real email.

sections.heading: Prepare a certificate
sections.text: As Accountant, choose Prepare payment certificate. Enter the claim date and cumulative claimed/assessed completion for each stage. Completion is a percentage of that stage. Previous approved assessments are loaded by the server. Allocations must total 100%; assessed completion cannot exceed claimed completion or fall below previously certified completion. Advance is included once in the initial schedule.

sections.heading: Review in order
sections.text: Save the draft, inspect its three-page PDF and Submit. Reviewer 1 approves first, then Reviewer 2, then Approver. Wrong-role/order and self-approval are blocked. A return needs a reason. The original preparer can create a fresh revision from a returned certificate; old evidence remains on the old revision. Competing assessments cannot reuse a changed certified baseline.

sections.heading: Confirm the draft invoice
sections.text: Final certificate approval creates exactly one linked draft invoice. Review Draft Invoices and record the confirming client's name, evidence reference and exact net amount. Draft print previews are clearly marked and do not appear in posted AR. The approved financial version is bound to the confirmation.

sections.heading: Issue with finance review
sections.text: A Finance Administrator can issue after confirmation and an explicit tax-treatment reason/rate. This release supports reviewed 0%/5% arithmetic only. Full statutory invoice/credit-note templates, tax-point deadlines, advances/retention policies, FX and provider validation remain incomplete. Treat its invoice records as local evaluation records until finance acceptance is completed.

pages.title: 5 · Cash, corrections and statements
pages.intro: Posted records remain immutable. Corrections are separate, dated entries.

sections.heading: Record and allocate receipts
sections.text: Use Collections > Record receipt for actual bank/cash receipts. Enter the correct customer, unique reference, receipt date, amount and method. From Receivables choose Allocate cash, select a receipt and a matching invoice, then enter the amount/effective date. Available cash, open balance, customer linkage and dates are checked. Recording a promise is not recording cash.

sections.heading: Post controlled corrections
sections.text: Finance Administrators use Corrections > Record correction. Credit note reduces open AR, net sales and VAT proportionally to the original invoice. Write-off reduces AR without changing sales/VAT. Both are capped at the current open balance; reverse allocations first if needed. A paid-invoice customer-credit policy is not implemented.

sections.heading: Refunds and reversals
sections.text: Record a Refund only against unapplied cash; this records the event and does not send money. Allocation reversal restores cash and invoice availability, allowing controlled reallocation. Receipt reversal reverses its active allocations and the receipt once. Refunded receipts cannot also be reversed. Every correction needs a clear reason and a valid effective date. Never change or delete original posted rows.

sections.heading: Reconcile historical views
sections.text: Receivables uses issue/allocation/correction dates through the selected as-of date. Future cash or corrections do not alter earlier positions. Statements include invoices, receipts, credits, write-offs, refunds and receipt reversals. Customer net exposure equals open AR less unapplied cash. Dashboard sales are net of credits and exclude VAT; collections are net of refunds/reversals.

sections.heading: Print and export
sections.text: Use the statement PDF/CSV controls and certificate PDF links. Check dates, AED basis and customer/project before sharing outside the application. Offline Share does not deliver email. Controlled statutory final-invoice and credit-note PDFs remain pending. Long certificate schedules are rejected when they cannot fit the controlled three-page template.

pages.title: 6 · Backup, recovery and support
pages.intro: Backups and local recovery need no API keys; Windows identity protection still matters.

sections.heading: Create a local encrypted backup
sections.text: Stop the application using Stop-SALES360.bat. Run Backup-SALES360.bat from the installation folder. It creates an encrypted .s360local file under your data/backups folder, including a database dump, original documents, protected settings, keys and credentials where present. Preserve the backup securely. It is protected for the same Windows identity/machine, not a portable disaster-recovery format.

sections.heading: Restore only into isolation
sections.text: Use Restore-SALES360.bat --restore "C:\path\backup.s360local" --data-dir "C:\new-isolated-folder". The destination must not already exist. File hashes are verified; restored external jobs/identity mail are suppressed, unused recovery tokens are invalidated and sessions are revoked. Check restored totals and documents before using it. Production cross-machine key recovery, backup scheduling/offsite monitoring and automatic pre-upgrade rollback remain pending.

sections.heading: Offline password recovery
sections.text: Use Forgot password with your registered email or username. An Administrator can request a reset in User access, then open Setting > Recovery mailbox. Refresh after a moment and open the local one-use link, or open an Outlook/default mail draft. Windows fallback: run Open-Outlook-Recovery.bat in the installation folder. Choose the recovery email, review the draft and click Send yourself. Links expire after 30 minutes and revoke existing sessions. The link opens on the SALES360 PC while it is running; username-only accounts have no deliverable email. Passwords are never sent in email.

sections.heading: Locate data and logs
sections.text: Program files normally live under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\SALES360. Business data normally lives separately under %LOCALAPPDATA%\SALES360\data. Check server.log and postgres.log if startup fails. Do not delete the PostgreSQL folder or copy live database files as a backup. Stop before repairing/upgrading. Uninstall preserves business data. The installer is unsigned; do not bypass Windows security warnings.

sections.heading: Release acceptance boundary
sections.text: This evaluated offline release adds supplied-format financial migration and module-level work areas. OCR/scanner acceptance, statutory tax documents, project-specific scopes/delegation, independent security acceptance and the full 100,000-record/25-session workload benchmark remain pending. A 25-concurrent-read smoke test on a small fixture is not that benchmark. Review the status and verification documents.

pages.title: 7 · Analytics & Reports
pages.intro: Customer and project analysis · date filters · Excel and PDF downloads

sections.heading: Generate a report
sections.text: Open Analytics & Reports. Choose a report, From date, To date and optional customer/project filters. Click Generate report. The preview shows 50 rows per page; use Previous/Next. Download Excel or Download PDF exports every matching row. Each file includes the selected period, currency and report basis. Reports are management records, not statutory invoices.

sections.heading: Ageing and outstanding
sections.text: Receivables ageing lists open invoices, due dates and ageing buckets at the To date. Customer outstanding and Project outstanding group those balances. The From date does not remove older unpaid invoices. Balances include invoice VAT. Unapplied cash is not assigned to a project or deducted from invoice AR until allocation.

sections.heading: Collections and cash
sections.text: Customer collections and Cash receipts use actual receipt/refund/reversal dates in the selected period, including unapplied cash. Project collections uses allocation effective dates and subtracts allocation reversals on their effective dates. Therefore customer cash and project collections can differ; the report explains this. A project filter is unavailable for receipt-date cash reports.

sections.heading: Movement, sales and adjustments
sections.text: Receivables opening / movement / closing reconciles opening AR + gross invoices - credits/write-offs - net allocations = closing AR. Reconciliation difference should be zero. Invoiced sales and VAT uses posted sales net of credit notes; write-offs do not reduce sales. Financial adjustments lists correction types and reasons. Ask Finance to review any difference before using the result.

pages.title: 8 · Utility, Setting and repair
pages.intro: Offline accounting exchange · personal appearance · controlled support

sections.heading: Tally on this PC
sections.text: Open Utility. Start Tally, load a company and enable its HTTP/XML server (normally port 9000). Enter the local port and click Test local connection as Administrator. The test reads company names only. Export customer masters as XML for reviewed manual import into a test Tally company. The XML contains basic ledger names/email; tax/TRN and voucher mapping require Tally-edition review. Duplicate legal names must be reconciled. Automatic voucher posting/synchronization is not implemented.

sections.heading: Zoho and other ERP
sections.text: Zoho Books opens only when you choose its external link and needs internet. Direct cloud sync is not configured; Zoho requires OAuth authorization and an organization. File exchange needs no API keys: use the full customer-master Excel export, Analytics Excel reports and supported reviewed workbook imports. Other ERP formats require a reviewed mapping. No background external connection is needed to run SALES360.

sections.heading: Change password, roles and theme
sections.text: Open Setting. Enter your current password and matching new password (12–128 characters). Saving signs out every session; sign in with the new password. Administrators can open Assign roles, duties & work areas and Company settings. Choose black, blue, grey or pink; your browser remembers the theme, including sign-in.

sections.heading: Diagnose and repair
sections.text: Setting > Run diagnostics checks database connectivity, program components, expected folders and negative invoice balances. Run safe repair recreates transient folders only; it never edits the ledger, keys or originals. If the app cannot open, run Repair-SALES360.bat from the installation folder. It checks bundled libraries and manifest file hashes. Follow the advice; stop SALES360 and rerun the installer in the same program folder if files are damaged. Keep business data and backups. Never delete database files or keys to fix an error.

pages.title: 9 - Version 8 setup and customer imports
pages.intro: Administrator-created users, company periods and source-format Excel

sections.heading: USER management
sections.text: Sign in as System Administrator. Open Setting > USER management > Create user. Enter full name, username or email login, registered recovery email and initial password twice. Choose Administrator, Super user or User, a separate financial workflow duty, and allowed work areas. Create the account and share its initial password privately. The user can change it under Setting. Existing users can be suspended or reassigned; saving access revokes their sessions. Public offline self-registration is disabled. System Administrator has all business workflow permissions, including financial approvals. Assign this role only to trusted owners; its actions and approval overrides remain auditable.

sections.heading: Company and accounting period
sections.text: The first-run wizard creates the local company. Use Company settings to edit legal details, TRN, accounting period and policy review records. Existing installations keep existing accounts and business data; they do not display owner signup again. Enter missing accounting dates manually after upgrading. The configured period is a reporting preference, not a year-end closing lock. Reports retain explicit From and To date filters.

sections.heading: Customer master import
sections.text: Customers has a prominent Import Customer Statement of Accounts button and a separate Import customer master button. Download the corresponding Excel format and select a workbook. The SOA workflow fills missing customer fields and creates/matches projects automatically after the preview is approved. Existing nonblank fields are preserved by default. Choose explicit replacement only after reviewing supplied address/email/terms and project descriptions. Missing customer details can be completed manually afterwards.

sections.heading: Import financial statements
sections.text: The SOA Import menu is the dedicated migration screen. Use one statement sheet per customer/project and copy the sheet for additional projects. Optional L1 customer code, L2 billing email, L3 credit terms, L4 reviewed contract fee, L5 category and L6 location enrich masters. Unknown fees remain zero with Needs contract review status; this is not an assumed contract value. The real receivables and collections can still be reported immediately after posting.

sections.heading: Forgotten Administrator password
sections.text: Choose Forgot password and enter the registered recovery email or username. Offline mode saves a short-lived, one-use link addressed to the registered email in the private local mailbox. As the same Windows account that owns the data, run Open-Outlook-Recovery.bat in the program folder to open the draft, even if SALES360 is signed out. Outlook/default mail must be configured and internet is needed to send to an inbox; sending is manual. The protected local message provides the offline fallback. Never email passwords. A different Windows account cannot decrypt this installation.

pages.title: 10 - Version 8 import and go-live checks
pages.intro: Automatic masters, reconciled balances and protection against rebilling historical work

sections.heading: 1. Prepare and preview
sections.text: Use the supplied SOA format. Customer legal name E4 and project code B4 identify records; names, codes and valid TRNs are checked for ambiguity. Conflicting owners/TRNs or duplicate invoice references block automatic posting. The master plan lists each source sheet, customer/project match and planned creation/update. Preview changes no ledger or master records.

sections.heading: 2. Approve and import
sections.text: Review totals, captured fields and warnings. Approve the master plan, included VAT treatment, AED currency, finance reference and posted-invoice confirmation. Commit runs customer/project changes, invoices and dated receipt allocations in one transaction. A conflict rolls everything back. Exact file retries are idempotent; changed files can reuse exact unchanged invoices. Do not also import an opening balance for the same debt.

sections.heading: 3. Complete customer information
sections.text: Open Customers > View / edit all fields. Add missing address, registration, tax, contact and e-invoicing details manually. Default automatic updates fill missing values and retain existing nonblank manual fields. The separate full 25-column customer master import can overwrite blank fields, so review it separately. Stored validation status is an operator record, not a registration verification.

sections.heading: 4. Review project fees and opening billed work
sections.text: Historical imports place projects in Needs contract review status. Open Projects, select a project, then Edit project / review contract fee. Enter the real contract fee and category. For existing billed work, enter a review reference and previously billed completion for each milestone. Its calculated net must equal the displayed already billed/approved amount. Cash received does not reduce previously billed work. Confirm to enable new certificate billing. Later certificates carry this opening assessment forward instead of billing it again.

sections.heading: 5. Verify balances before live use
sections.text: Check created customer/project counts, invoices, collections and source outstanding against the imported files. Generate customer/project outstanding, ageing and opening/movement/closing reports for the correct date. Confirm reconciliation difference is zero. Review projects with unknown fees and any ambiguous mappings before preparing new work. Back up and verify a restore before entering real-company transactions.

sections.heading: Known limits remain
sections.text: Supported source postings are AED with explicitly reviewed 0% or 5% included VAT and one dated collection per invoice row. OCR, ASP electronic invoice transmission, advanced variation/retention rules, automatic monthly Supervision schedule mapping, independent security review and full-scale workload/clean-PC acceptance remain outside this update. Real email sending needs configured mail and connectivity.

pages.title: 11 · UAE VAT calculation and manual credits
pages.intro: Statutory Compliance > VAT. AED calculations, linked final invoices and reviewed VAT201 entries.

sections.heading: 1. Review company and invoice facts
sections.text: Complete the company legal name, registered address and 15-digit TRN. Final invoices link automatically. Under Statutory Compliance > Invoice VAT review, load the date range and confirm the tax point, supply date, description, treatment and supplier establishment Emirate. Complete the customer address/TRN in Customer master before the first review. Standard-rated posted VAT must equal 5%; zero-rated, exempt and out-of-scope classifications require zero posted VAT and a treatment evidence reference. Review earlier payments, continuous supplies and the correct place of supply; the software does not infer these from a customer address.

sections.heading: 2. Create the assigned VAT period
sections.text: Choose Calculation > Create an FTA-assigned VAT period. Enter the actual dates assigned by the FTA. Overlapping working papers are blocked. The initial due date is period end plus 28 days. Confirm the portal deadline, including holidays or specific FTA directions. An adjusted deadline needs a reference. The calculation shows VAT201 boxes and a detailed final invoice register. Draft invoices are excluded. Credit notes follow their effective date; cash allocations and write-offs do not reduce output VAT.

sections.heading: 3. Enter manual input credits and adjustments
sections.text: Expand Manual input credits & adjustments. Add an entry, select the VAT201 box and enter the taxable amount, VAT or recoverable portion, signed VAT adjustment, source document reference and an explanation of eligibility/treatment. Box 9 is standard-rated expenses; Box 10 is recoverable reverse-charge input tax. Box 3 and 6 capture reverse-charge/import output tax. Box 1 can capture evidenced non-invoice supplies, but do not duplicate an existing final invoice. Every manual entry requires evidence. Only claim the eligible portion, with blocked expenses, apportionment and recovery periods reviewed. Save entries and the confirmed deadline before approving.

sections.heading: 4. Read the liability
sections.text: Output VAT includes linked supplies, dated credit notes and signed output adjustments. Recoverable input VAT includes reviewed entries and signed input adjustments. Net VAT equals output VAT less recoverable input VAT. A negative net is a recoverable period position, not an automatic refund or a carried-forward balance applied by the software. Payments to the FTA are separate.

pages.title: 12 · VAT review, filing records and tax invoices
pages.intro: Local preparation and records remain offline. Portal filing requires internet and your own FTA login.

sections.heading: 5. Review and approve the current sources
sections.text: Open Review & Submission. Resolve all invoice/company issues and read the warnings. Record the finance reconciliation reference and confirm completeness of supplies/advances/imports, input eligibility and tax-point/deadline review. Accountant prepares; Finance Administrator approves and records filing. The System Administrator can perform all implemented duties. Any change to the source fingerprint requires another review before filing can be recorded. Existing ordinary users need the compliance work area assigned under Setting > USER management.

sections.heading: 6. File in the FTA portal yourself
sections.text: VAT Return file opens https://eservices.tax.gov.ae/#/Logon in a separate browser tab. Download the Excel/PDF working paper, sign in and file the return yourself. SALES360 does not sign in, transmit a return or pay tax. After actual submission, return to Review & Submission and record the filing date, acknowledgement reference and evidence location. The period must be closed. The local Filed status is a user-recorded acknowledgement, not independent FTA verification.

sections.heading: 7. Preserve the filed return and report totals
sections.text: Filed working papers are immutable. Exports use the frozen calculation, with the period and acknowledgement. Analytics & Reports > VAT returns filed shows filed period amounts, selected-period totals and the all-period net total, with Excel and PDF exports. The date filter selects returns by period-end. Customer/project filters are unavailable for company VAT returns. Later historical postings are flagged for reconciliation while the original filed amounts stay unchanged. Use the applicable FTA correction process; do not overwrite filed history.

sections.heading: 8. Print and test five tax invoices
sections.text: Under Invoice VAT review, reviewed standard-rated and zero-rated invoices have a Tax invoice PDF link. Each document contains issuer and customer details, sequential reference, issue/supply dates, services, quantity, unit price, discount, VAT and AED totals. Exempt/out-of-scope records require commercial documents. Five fictional tax invoice PDFs and control files are included in VAT Test Examples. Their original five-invoice net is AED 150,000 and VAT is AED 5,000. Manual inputs and adjustments demonstrate an AED 4,615 liability; additional regression postings have separate control figures. These files are fictional. Applicable electronic-invoicing/ASP obligations, specialist tax treatments and independent finance acceptance remain separate.
